summary: The exact candidate fixes the independently reported Rust generation-egress omission and passes Python and rebuilt-Rust validation. It is still a partial original-issue fix because Rust-server mode replaces the HTTP worker's watch-plus-piggyback behavior with a piggyback-only in-memory cache: idle/no-generation ranks have no watch fallback. The Rust /v1/loads implementation also lacks the existing Prometheus format and accelerator metadata parity.

tests.command: git show 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365:python/sglang/srt/rust_server/server.py | sed -n '/def push_generation/,/def _build_mm_spec/p' | rg load_snapshot
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence on the recorded base: RustServer.push_generation had no load_snapshot encoder path, so token egress could not carry the scheduler report.

13 focused Python tests passed at exact candidate commit, including the generation-frame column, best-effort collection, timestamp arbitration, watch merge on the Python path, and multi-tokenizer fanout.
With private pinned Rust 1.92, all 265 sglang-server tests passed, including decoding and newest-per-rank cache coverage.

Built the changed optimized native Rust library from the exact candidate source. Direct import resolved to /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-9f1c04f34372/cargo-target/release/libsglang_server.so and exposed the native Server class.

Independent adversarial architecture check: every Rust load cache write originates in decoded generation frames; there is no watch/SHM/ZMQ reader feeding the Rust HTTP cache. Therefore idle and pre-generation ranks are absent rather than backed by the required watching mode.

tests.command: source comparison of python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/v1_loads.py with candidate rust/sglang-server/src/api_server/common.rs
tests.what_was_measured: The established endpoint supports format=prometheus and reports accelerator topology; the candidate Rust endpoint explicitly returns HTTP 400 for non-JSON and returns null topology fields.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X was visible to the prepared interpreter (Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2), but this deterministic Rust transport/cache review did not execute model inference or GPU numerical work.
remaining_counterexamples: With Rust server mode enabled, /v1/loads is backed only by snapshots consumed from generation frames. Before the first generated response, during idle-only operation, or when best-effort snapshot collection returns None, no watch-mode snapshot feeds the Rust cache, so the rank is absent despite the original requirement to keep watching mode and always retain the latest load for external query.
Rust /v1/loads rejects format=prometheus with HTTP 400 even though the existing endpoint contract supports Prometheus output.
Rust /v1/loads returns accelerator and num_accelerators as null rather than preserving the established endpoint metadata contract.
remaining_limitations: No live tiny-model server was launched; the decisive remaining defect is a deterministic missing Rust watch-data source, while the native encoder/decoder was compiled and unit-tested.
No multi-rank or multi-node serving environment was exercised.
The available deterministic tiny Llama fixture could validate transport and engine execution only, not semantic accuracy or distributed behavior; no such model claim is made.
NVIDIA, CPU-only serving, and non-Llama model architectures were not tested.
